question: Does it matter if the definition of reflection is applied arbitrarily?
premises: An objector might claim the definition is applied arbitrarily.
If it is arbitrary, the universe could just as well be called the original image.
Wise people are concerned with the nature of reality, not with conventional terminology.
inference: The focus should remain on the reality of the reflection, not on arbitrary naming conventions.
plain_english: If this arrangement of the definition is arbitrary, then let the universe be called the original image. Wise people are concerned with reality itself, not with conventional terminology.
